title: The Choir Step Shared
youtube_title: The Choir Step Shared | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Lale is just outside the fun, close to a choir step shared so nobody stood in the draft alone. Bodhi changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Lale has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
